messages:
sam lee: Heads-up: planning a regional priority-swap for `zephyr-7b-v1` in the model catalog during next Tuesday's change window (2026-04-07 02:00-03:00 UTC).
sam lee: We want to move the quant-8bit variant ahead of float-16 in the fallback ladder to lower memory footprint during high-concurrency bursts. No model weights change.
tess nguyen: Is this driven by telemetry or internal cost ops?
sam lee: Telemetry + ops: recent autoscaler evictions during peak test runs. Benchmarks show similar output quality on our representative promptset and ~40% memory reduction.
ryan infra: Region note: ap-south has scarce spare capacity this week. Recommend staged regional rollout: global traffic gating -> NA -> EU -> APAC hold.
sam lee: Agreed. Plan: config apply at 02:00Z to NA canary (3% traffic for 10m), then EU at 02:20Z if metrics green. APAC remains pinned to old ordering until manual opt-in.
marta product: QA wants rollback criteria and a tiny human-review sample. Propose: rollback if error rate increases by 1% absolute (>1.2% total) for 5m OR p95 latency >1.8x baseline for 10m OR quality eval (10 prompts) drop in BLEU-like metric >4%.
tess nguyen: Add an infra gate: node evictions >0.5 per minute in any region -> abort further rollout.
sam lee: I'll encode those thresholds into the deploybot preflight. Also adding enterprise_pinlist so Dedicated customers retain previous fallback ordering unless opted in.
ryan infra: Please include a toggle to limit rollout to specific pools (reserved vs shared) — some enterprise pools are reserved and should not be auto-updated.
sam lee: Will set `pool_scope: ['shared']` for this run.
tess nguyen: Can you paste the exact catalog diff?
sam lee: Paste below:
```
catalog:
  zephyr-7b-v1:
    enabled: true
    fallback_priority:
      - zephyr-7b-v1-quant8
      - zephyr-7b-v1-fp16
      - zephyr-7b-legacy
    rollout_plan:
      na_canary: 2026-04-07T02:00Z
      eu: 2026-04-07T02:20Z
      apac: manual-hold
    pool_scope: ['shared']
    enterprise_pinlist: [acct-4001, acct-4022]
```
deploybot: DeployBot: Received catalog-change for `zephyr-7b-v1` from @sam lee. Preflight will run: canary 3% (10m), telemetry checks (errors/latency), quality-eval (10 prompts), and pool-scope enforcement. Reply `@deploybot approve` to proceed or `@deploybot hold`. Auto-cancel in 25m.
ryan infra: Approving infra side pending canary telemetry. I'll watch node eviction streams.
marta product: QA approves conditional on the 10-prompt manual review being green. I'll be on watch.
tess nguyen: Small ask — include the sample QA prompts in the preflight so results are reproducible in the ticket.
sam lee: Will attach prompt set and expected-check patterns. Also adding release-note stub: what changed, reason (memory/eviction), rollback criteria, how to opt-out (enterprise_pinlist), and contact for postmortem.
deploybot: DeployBot: Preflight scheduled start 2026-04-07T02:00Z. Canary scope: NA 3% for 10m. Monitoring: errors, p95 latency, quality eval, node evictions.
ryan infra: If any eviction alerts trigger during the canary, abort EU rollout and revert NA if error + evictions correlate.
sam lee: Ack. We'll make the rollback policy conservative: abort further rollout on any eviction spike; only global rollback if canary fails hard.
marta product: I'll draft the release notes and the short QA checklist and push to the release-notes PR after a green canary.
tess nguyen: I'll run the local reproducer tests against the quant variant tonight to sanity-check.
sam lee: Thanks — will circle back with canary summary after run. :white_check_mark:
ryan infra: :eyes:
marta product: :rocket:
